attackers_goals: Manipulate IAM configuration to strengthen the foothold in the cloud environment of the organization, by creating new accounts, modifying credentials, and permissions. Using the modified accounts, the attacker may perform additional activities in an evasive manner.
description: A cloud identity performed an unusual IAM operation.
investigative_actions: Check the identity's role designation in the organization. Verify that the identity did not perform any sensitive IAM operation that it shouldn't.
